stories.headline: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown expansion launches with ocean exploration
stories.summary: Pearl Abyss released Charting the Unknown on October 29, adding ship travel, underwater exploration, new storylines and expanded housing and management activities. The paid expansion substantially broadens what players can do across Pywel and requires the base game.

stories.headline: Age of Empires IV adds Vikings, Scots and co-op Crucible challenges
stories.summary: Raiders of the North launched October 29 with two playable civilizations, four new Crucible missions, two northern biomes and two-player co-op support for Crucible. The expansion adds distinct raiding and defensive strategies for PC RTS players.

stories.headline: Monster Train 2 announces The Punished clan DLC for November 10
stories.summary: Shiny Shoe unveiled The Punished, a paid November 10 expansion led by Archus. Its new clan turns damage to friendly units and card sacrifices at the Monolith into combat advantages. The studio says this will conclude the game's planned post-launch content updates.

stories.headline: Planet Coaster 2 launches Spooktacular Pack and free Update 12
stories.summary: Frontier released the Spooktacular Pack on October 29 with customizable walkthrough attractions, seven rides and more than 700 scenery pieces. A separate free update adds Reaction Points, photo stand-ins and a Scared guest reaction, expanding park storytelling even without the paid DLC.

stories.headline: Cairn receives free Deep Water climbing DLC
stories.summary: The Game Bakers released On the Trail: Deep Water on October 29 at no extra cost to Cairn owners. It adds the Haken and Ruka cliffs, the Lamu climbing gym, water soloing, playable Marco and free-roam climbing options, giving existing players fresh routes to master.

stories.headline: Hexologic is free to keep on Steam until October 31
stories.summary: Steam's limited promotion makes the Sudoku-inspired hexagonal puzzle game Hexologic free to claim permanently until October 31 at 17:00 UTC (18:00 in Belgium). It includes more than 90 puzzles across six worlds; claiming before the deadline adds the full game to your library.

stories.headline: ATMOSFAR enters Steam Early Access with four-player sky survival
stories.summary: Apog Labs launched ATMOSFAR in Early Access on October 29. Players explore floating islands using customizable Wasp aircraft and build a mobile Cloud Cruiser airship base, alone or with up to three friends. The initial build has two regions, with more content planned during development.

stories.headline: Probably Stolen developer reports 350,000 sales in its first 24 hours
stories.summary: Questing Goose Studio says its cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator sold more than 350,000 copies during the first day after its October 28 PC launch, reaching more than 112,000 peak concurrent Steam players. The reported figures mark an unusually strong debut for an independent management game.
